targetWords.contextZh: 试点结束后，大学同意实施一个暂定版本。它对考试成绩的影响很小，但学生主动提问的意愿发生了深刻变化。这并不意味着成绩的重要性应该降低，也不意味着每种新方法都该取代旧方法。保留有效做法、检验失败原因、为个人发展留下空间，教育才能取得成效。在变化的世界中学习，既需要延续，也需要修改熟悉答案的勇气。

paragraphs.en: When a university announced that every student would undergo a year of practical training, the proposal was controversial. Some teachers feared that conventional lectures would become obsolete; others saw a compelling reason to change. In a world where careers fluctuate and knowledge grows rapidly, it is inevitable that education must adapt. Yet an ambiguous promise to prepare people for the future offers little guidance. The university needed to formulate a clear purpose: help students retain useful knowledge while learning to verify unfamiliar claims.
paragraphs.zh: 一所大学宣布，所有学生都要接受一年的实践训练，这个提案引起了争议。有些教师担心传统课堂会被淘汰，另一些人则看到了改革的充分理由。职业环境不断变化，知识迅速增长，教育作出调整是必然的。然而，含糊地承诺“让学生为未来做好准备”并不能提供多少指引。大学需要制定明确目标：帮助学生保留有用的知识，同时学会核实陌生的说法。

paragraphs.en: A preliminary survey revealed a substantial difference between students who enjoyed exploring questions and those who studied only for grades. The first group showed persistent curiosity and a resilient response to failure. Their motivation was largely intrinsic, unlike the prevalent habit of studying only to pass a test. A financial incentive could compensate students for travel expenses, but it could not create that curiosity. Researchers remained skeptical of claims that technology alone would solve the problem. Their empirical findings suggested that thoughtful teaching could foster confidence and facilitate cooperation more effectively than expensive equipment.
paragraphs.zh: 初步调查发现，喜欢探索问题的学生与只为成绩学习的学生之间存在明显差异。前一组有持续的好奇心，面对失败也更有韧性。他们的动力主要来自内心，不同于普遍存在的只为通过考试而学习的习惯。经济奖励可以补偿交通开支，却无法创造好奇心。研究人员对“仅靠技术就能解决问题”的说法仍持怀疑态度。实证结果表明，用心教学在培养信心、促进合作方面，可能比昂贵设备更有效。

paragraphs.en: The planners had to contemplate several difficult choices. Should they impose one schedule on everyone, or accommodate students with jobs and family duties? A rigid timetable could constrain participation and hamper the very progress it was meant to encourage. Students in vulnerable circumstances might see their prospects deteriorate if the university chose to neglect their needs. A legitimate request for flexibility deserved attention. Providing accessible materials would mitigate these risks and make the program compatible with different lives. Such support was essential to a sustainable system.
paragraphs.zh: 规划人员必须认真考虑几项困难的选择：是给所有人强加同一个时间表，还是照顾有工作和家庭责任的学生？僵硬的安排可能限制参与，阻碍项目本来希望推动的进步。如果大学忽略处境脆弱的学生，他们的前景可能恶化。合理的灵活安排请求值得重视。提供容易获取的资料，可以减轻这些风险，让项目适应不同的生活状况。这类支持是建立可持续体系的必要条件。

paragraphs.en: One tutor chose to advocate a small pilot instead of an elaborate reform. Students would utilize local interviews to investigate how work was changing. They learned to discriminate between reliable testimony and attractive speculation. They also discovered that two reports could contradict each other without either author intending to manipulate the evidence. Discussing those differences helped reinforce careful judgment. Teachers were asked not to suppress disagreement, since doing so could undermine trust. Even reluctant participants began to contribute when their questions were taken seriously.
paragraphs.zh: 一位导师主张先开展小规模试点，而不是推行复杂的改革。学生通过本地访谈调查工作方式的变化，学习辨别可靠证言与吸引人的猜测。他们还发现，两份报告可能互相矛盾，却不代表任何一位作者有意操纵证据。讨论这些差异有助于加强审慎判断。教师被要求不要压制不同意见，因为那可能削弱信任。当问题受到认真对待时，连原本不情愿的参与者也开始贡献想法。

paragraphs.en: After the pilot, the university agreed to implement a tentative version of the program. Its effects on examination scores were marginal, but the change in students' willingness to ask questions was profound. The lesson was not that grades should diminish in importance or that every new method should replace an old one. Education succeeds when institutions preserve what works, examine what fails, and give people room to develop. Learning in a changing world requires both continuity and the courage to revise a familiar answer.
